name: @prism3/storybook
description: The arm 1 Storybook (#3408 S5, thin): every Prism3 component in both delivery forms, the custom element and plain HTML/CSS, one story per state.

scripts.build: npm run -w @prism3/tokens build && storybook build --quiet --output-dir storybook-static
scripts.check:build: npx tsx check-build.ts && npx tsx check-geometry.ts && npx tsx compare-figma-geometry.ts --self-test
scripts.check:a11y: npx tsx check-axe.ts && npx tsx check-aria.ts && npx tsx check-keyboard.ts && npx tsx check-rtl.ts

// devDependencies: postcss and rolldown are Vite's, pinned here so Vite resolves releases at least two weeks old (#3408 S5); nothing here imports them.
